messages:
maria: Quick run  need a micro-plan for SEO + redirects for launch posts + webinar. Focus: benchmark narrative visibility, microcase fragment indexing, clean redirect chains, and UTMs for webinar leads. Who picks what?

sam: Ill own keyword-to-fragment mapping. plan: one pillar + 3 microcase fragments per benchmark (short, shareable). will add intent tags and preferred CTA per fragment.

ajake: Ill handle schema + indexing hints. adding Event JSON-LD for webinar, FAQ for benchmark, and a snippet for data-vocabulary microdata where needed. will also add x-robots-tag rules for staging.

olivia: Ill do internal link equity plan & redirect diff. proposal: surface microcase fragments from pillar via jump links, weight nav links with data-link-weight attr for GA. redirect rules: 301 for permanent, avoid >1 hop, map retired posts to best fragment. will run chain detector.
anita: Ill own UTMs & lead routing: use utm_campaign=launch_32578, utm_content=fragmentA, include hidden campaign_id for SFDC mapping. I will validate GTM events prelaunch.

seo-ci-bot: CI queued: redirect-chain-scan. add CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-3257809999.csv to trigger.

sam: Seed sheet uploaded: https://drive.redwood/seo/kw-fragments-3257809999.csv  contains fragment titles, H1/H2 hints, intent, and CTA mapping.

ajake: Example JSON-LD snippet for webinar: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-09-02T18:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```

olivia: Redirect smoke: `curl -I -L https://redwood.ai/old-benchmark` -> expect 200 and single 301 hop. Ill post the diff + chain log after CI.

anita: SFDC mapping: campaign=LAUNCH_32578, source=webinar, content param maps to fragment_id. will test with staging forms and confirm lead attribution.

maria: Preflight checklist: KW fragments locked, schema validated, internal link weights in place, redirect CSV tested, UTMs wired + SFDC test pass, sitemap includes fragment entries with priority tags. 24h preflight sign-off.

eng-release: Note: redirect window Wed 03:00-04:00 UTC. Need final CSV + revert list 12h prior.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status: 2/6 (KW fragments, schema snippet). Waiting for redirect CSV, internal-link diff, UTMs + GTM test, sitemap update, SFDC validation.

maria: Good. Keep updates here and drop curl logs / Search Console screenshots when ready.
